description:
Tasha's rascal alchemist, Sylvère, has heard the prophecy that he will awaken as a hero, and Yewers, the priest of the Great Temple, has come to bring him to the capital.

Without a priest, the hero would run wild, but he says he's there to protect the peace of all...

Somehow, this guy can't help but be a rascal?!

"If this rascal is a trial, I'll accept it...!"

Will Sylvère and Yewers be able to reach the capital safely?
